name: work-session-ui
implemented: Added WorkSessionDraft for customer nickname, server, expected work time, price basis, and memo inputs.
Added long-session recommendation when expected work time is 180 minutes or longer.
Added WorkSessionController covering start, recording start, in-progress, capture, manual save, hold/resume/complete/cancel/delete confirmation states.
Added confirmation warning messages for complete, cancel, and delete so destructive actions cannot execute from a single click.
Added desktop tests for required field validation, long-session mode recommendation, capture/manual-save behavior, and cancel/delete confirmation requirements.
